mutants.description: Rotate exactly AT bearer expiry instead of 60s ahead (window where every request 401s).
Rotate 60s AFTER bearer expiry (sign flip).
Foreground re-check only refreshes a bearer that is already expired, not one with < 5 min left.
No foreground re-check at all (a bearer that expired while suspended is never refreshed until the timer, which did not fire).
A refused refresh token (401/403) is retried forever instead of ending the session.
Retryable/non-retryable flipped: a transient failure signs the user out, a refusal keeps retrying.
A keeper started without a bearer (persisted session at launch) never refreshes.
The keeper keeps using the SPENT refresh token after a rotation (second rotation is refused by the server).
Backoff counter never resets after a success (retry delays keep growing across the session).
An in-flight refresh that lands after stopSessionKeeper() (sign-out) still calls onRotated with the new tokens.
No exponential backoff: every transient failure retries after the 1s floor.
stopSessionKeeper() does not bump the generation: a stopped keeper's in-flight refresh still adopts tokens / signs out.
Concurrent refreshes allowed (a route 401 during a scheduled rotation spends the refresh token twice).
After a rotation nothing is scheduled: the bearer expires for good after the first rotation.
A 403 from /v1/auth/refresh is treated as transient (retry forever) instead of a refusal.
Any non-2xx from /v1/auth/refresh (including 5xx) is a refusal: server trouble signs the user out.
A network failure/timeout during refresh is a refusal: going offline signs the user out.
Logout is sent without the bearer (server cannot know which session to revoke).
Server-side revoke skipped entirely on sign-out.
expiresAt (unix seconds) is passed through as milliseconds: the keeper believes the bearer expired in 1970 and rotates on every tick.
Refresh sends the token under the wrong body key (server answers 400 → transient forever).
bearerTokenFor ignores the account binding: a client configured for account A gets account B's bearer.
A late 401 for an already-rotated bearer is reported against the CURRENT session.
clearApiSession is a no-op: the bearer survives sign-out in memory.
